what: IVT must now an individualised decision: the small subacute infarct 2 weeks ago is a relative contraindication (ischaemic stroke within 3 months, AHA/ASA 2026) weighed against size, timing, haemorrhagic risk and disability; giving or withholding are both acceptable after that assessment, never automatic. The prohibition 'Do not give IV thrombolysis' removed; key evidence, difficulty description and the antithrombotic must (timing if IVT given) aligned.
check_drug_interactions now recommended and out of the stop rule (class STOP-SCOPE).

Class LDL (ruling 7): the LDL < 70 mg/dL target removed from the statin must of the five non-atherosclerotic cases (P01, RM04 vertebral dissection; RM01 carotid dissection; P05, RP03 PFO); the must now reads 'Consider atorvastatin 80 mg' and states that the target applies to atherosclerotic disease. Cardioembolic cases with documented carotid or aortic atherosclerosis keep it.
